thread:
maria_g: quick sync  copy pass for site pages (hosted / dedicated / private). need hero lines + one supporting blurb each, plus 3 launch posts and webinar hook. timebox this 20m.

nate_prod: thinking headline angle: "Start small, scale predictably." benefit-first for hosted, capacity-first for dedicated, compliance-first for private. short subheads.

emma_design: can we standardize CTA verbs? e.g., Hosted = Try, Dedicated = Reserve, Private = Contact. keeps UX consistent across variants.

rory_growth: webinar idea: "Serving Economics at Real Scale"  pull in two metric hooks: cost reduction and latency preservation. need one customer quote for credibility.

maria_g: assigning benchmark narrative to nate. nate, can you include a one-line stat we can A/B test? something crisp like "3x lower serving spend" but back it with measurement context.

nate_prod: yep. draft: "In our benchmark set, Redwood reduced per-request serving spend by up to 3x while keeping p95 latency under 150ms." will append brief methodology line.

emma_design: for hero variants i sketched microcopy: Hosted: "Generate in minutes  pay-as-you-go"; Dedicated: "Guaranteed throughput  reserved capacity"; Private: "Air-gapped control  enterprise-grade compliance". each has 1-sentence supporting blurb. uploading comps to Figma.

cs_bot: CS snippet: "AcmeCorp moved inference from colo to Redwood Dedicated and cut tail latency by 40% during peak traffic." (source: case-request-452).

maria_g: good. legal_j: any red flags with using a customer name in launch posts?

legal_j: need written opt-in from AcmeCorp for public mention. otherwise use generic phrasing: "a Fortune 500 customer". also watch claims like "3x lower"  include "in internal benchmarks using open LLMs on 8x A100 equiv" as footnote.

rory_growth: thanks. we'll stage language: primary post uses non-identifying metric, press kit has exact customer quotes if approved.

maria_g: inbound lead routing: proposal: form field 'mode_interest' + 'company_size' + 'compliance_needs' + 'is_poc'. rule: if company_size >= 1000 OR compliance_needs=="yes" OR is_poc=="true" -> route to enterprise queue. else -> marketing nurture. also set hubspot property mapping. paste sample payload for eng: 

```
POST /api/leads
{
  "email": "...",
  "mode_interest": "hosted|dedicated|private",
  "company_size": "...",
  "compliance_needs": "yes|no",
  "is_poc": "true|false"
}
```

maria_g: devs, please implement as webhook with 200 on success and retry on 5xx.

emma_design: one more ask: Private page needs a low-friction CTA: "Request a private review" (single-click opens modal prefilled if logged in). place above the fold.

nate_prod: for the 3 launch posts timeline: teaser (day -3), benchmark highlight (day 0 launch), webinar invite (day +2). captions and assets assigned.

webinar-bot: Created webinar event: "Serving Economics at Real Scale" on 2026-05-07 10:00 PT. registration link: https://events.redwood.ai/serve-economics. Reminder: add partner by Friday EOD.

maria_g: copy freeze Wed COB. everyone review drafts in the doc I'll share. will tag design + growth for final CTA copy. thanks all.
